title: Company Ignite: Handoff & Fallout Plan (Q3 prep)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working plan to prepare for the Q3 company-wide cadence we are calling ‘Ignite’. The doc bundles three things: a minimal OKR draft to seed leadership discussion, an executive update outline for the all-hands, and a detailed handoff + fallout plan for cross-functional teams to reduce ambiguity after the all-hands.

Context / quick notes:
- Goal: align the company on the 90-day execution window (July–Sept) and make sure teams leave the all-hands with clear, owned next steps.
- Tone: candid and operational. This is not the final narrative for the town; it’s the internal scoping that feeds comms.
- Current status: draft OKRs below are intentionally compact. We will iterate with product and eng leads before finalizing.
- Key references: Confluence Ignite brief (linked), JIRA epic for comms (JIRA-EPIC-4721), PR with town slides (GH #24).

Timeline (high level):
- Mar 18–Mar 28: Leadership OKR review and edits (this doc + 1:1s).
- Apr 1: Draft comms + slide deck locked for exec review.
- Apr 7–11: Rehearsals (exec + hosts).
- Apr 14: All-hands (Ignite) town.
- Apr 15–May 2: Handoff window - teams convert town asks into JIRA tickets, designate owners, set first sprint goals.

Guiding constraints for the quarter:
- Prioritize reliability and cost predictability for customer-facing workloads (hosted + dedicated).
- Avoid broad new platform bets that would create integration churn mid-quarter.
- Measure impact: every OKR KR should map to a measurable metric or a named milestone.

Draft company-level OKRs (seed for leadership discussion)
OKR 1: Make inference predictable at scale
- KR1.1: Reduce 95th percentile production latency for hosted text-gen by 20% vs baseline (end of Q3).
- KR1.2: Decrease per-token cost for top-10 customers by 15% via batching and KV cache improvements.
- KR1.3: Ship a public performance profile for 3 Redwood-verified models with region-level latency baselines.

OKR 2: Enterprise readiness + private deployments
- KR2.1: Close 3 pilot agreements for Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) with named legal/compliance SLAs.
- KR2.2: Add KMS/HSM integration and automated audit exports for Private customers (MVP).
- KR2.3: Achieve internal runbook coverage and SLA playbooks for Dedicated customers (90% docs complete).

OKR 3: Developer-first velocity and cost controls
- KR3.1: Ship console UX improvements for rollouts (canary + AB) and reduce time-to-deploy by 30% for small teams.
- KR3.2: Pilot Redwood Optimize suggestions on 5 production workloads and show cost savings >= 10% on at least 3.
- KR3.3: Increase DevX NPS (internal SDK + quickstarts) by 7 points vs baseline.

Notes on OKRs: these are intentionally at the company level — each product/eng org should own 1–2 supporting OKRs that map directly to these KRs. We will iterate with product-hosted-api, eng-serving-runtime, and optimize teams.

Executive update outline (for all-hands speaker notes)
- Opening (CEO): Why Ignite? Rapid context (market + customer signals + operational priorities).
- Signal 1: Reliability and unit economics — show 2 slides: current latency/cost snapshot, target improvements, and customer stories.
- Signal 2: Enterprise momentum — highlight 2 pilots for Private + Dedicated wins.
- Signal 3: Developer velocity — demo of a quick rollout in Console (30s).
- Ask: what we need from everyone — a short list of concrete asks (below).
- Close: how we’ll measure success (weekly 1-pagers, dashboards) + where to find follow-ups.

All-hands: Run of show (operational)
- Host (15m before): Slack channel live, slide deck uploaded, AV check.
- 00:00–00:05 (Host): Welcome + housekeeping + agenda.
- 00:05–00:18 (CEO): Company state + Ignite framing (signals).
- 00:18–00:28 (Head of Eng): Reliability + performance brief (metrics + short demo).
- 00:28–00:36 (Head of Product): Enterprise & Private update (pilots and next steps).
- 00:36–00:44 (Head of DevX): Console & Optimize demo.
- 00:44–00:54 (Panel: Eng + Product + Sales): 3 moderated Qs (pre-collected + live).
- 00:54–01:00 (CEO): Closing + explicit asks + where to sign up for working groups.

Immediate asks (what teams should do in the 2-week handoff window)
- Each team (eng/product/platform) must create a 3-item sprint plan that maps to at least one company KR and add it to JIRA under EPIC JIRA-EPIC-4721. Owner + due date required.
- Designate a single point of contact for cross-team blockers (name in the EPIC).
- Submit one risk statement per sprint plan (how it could impede the KR).

Handoff process (detailed)
- Day 0 (post-town): Exec sends short recap + prioritized asks (one-pager).
- Day 1–3: Team leads convert asks into JIRA tickets, tag with ignite/okrs and assign owners.
- Day 4–10: Triage: Program managers run daily 15m standups for cross-team dependencies; SRE/infra to sign off on any latency-impacting changes.
- Day 11–30: First delivery window; weekly status updates in the ignite-status channel and a rolling deck for exec review.

Risks & mitigations (working list)
- Risk: Large refactor to batching/kv cache touches multiple runtime paths and could cause regression.
  - Mitigation: Canary on Dedicated pool only, automated perf/regression harness. Rollback playbook ready.
- Risk: Private pilot legal timelines slip.
  - Mitigation: Identify contract minimal viable SLOs, offer temporary interim terms to unblock pilots. Legal to provide templated language by Apr 1.
- Risk: Communication noise; teams unclear which asks are critical.
  - Mitigation: Numbered asks (1–3) in the exec one-pager, and triage call with PMs Day 2.

Open questions / decisions needed from execs:
- Q: Do we want to prioritize cost reduction (KR1.2) vs aggressive latency (KR1.1) if they conflict? (Decision needed by Mar 24).
- Q: Approve the list of pilot customers for Private (names are in the Confluence doc) — Legal/compliance go/no-go by Mar 28.
- Q: Confirm scope for Console demo (full rollout vs feature flag walkthrough) — product decision by Mar 20.

Comms plan (internal + external cadence)
- Internal: Exec one-pager + slack thread + dedicated ignite-status channel. Weekly executive digest (email) with short wins and blockers.
- External: Customer blog & community update after major signals are validated (post Q3 milestone). Sales enablement kit published Day 7 post-town.

Post-mortem and measurement
- 2-week pulse: quick survey to measure clarity on next steps (DevX + People Ops to run).
- Weekly success dashboard: latency/cost, Private pipeline, Optimize pilot savings, DevX NPS.
- After Q3: formal post-mortem with exec attendees + a decision ledger for any unresolved tradeoffs.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep slide deck lean — focus on 4 signals max. Don’t try to make a full product roadmap in the town.
- Rehearsal checklist: mic checks, video captions, backup slide deck (PDF) uploaded to drive.
- Need one clear CTA for ICs: join working groups or own a ticket; avoid a dozen vague asks.

Next steps / owners (short):
- Jordan: finalize exec one-pager & distribute to SLT by Mar 19.
- Aisha: coordinate rehearsals and finalize run-of-show by Apr 4.
- Marcus: lock metrics and dashboards for Head of Eng slide by Mar 22.
- Sophie: draft sales enablement kit & pilot customer comms (ready Day 7 post-town).
- Ravi: create the JIRA EPIC and template tickets for teams to clone (by Mar 18).

Appendix (quick links):
- Confluence: Ignite brief (linked)
- JIRA: JIRA-EPIC-4721
- Deck PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ignite-prep/pull/24

If you’re reading this and want to propose changes, drop a comment in the Confluence page or ping me (Jordan) in #ignite-planning. This doc will be updated after leadership sync on Mar 19.
